hadith:
Agriculture - Narrated `Abdullah:

The Prophet (ﷺ) got the date palm trees of the tribe of Bani-An-Nadir burnt and the trees cut down at a place called Al-Buwaira . Hassan bin Thabit said in a poetic verse: "The chiefs of Bani Lu'ai found it easy to watch fire spreading at Al-Buwaira."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Muhaymin - الْمُهَيْمِنُ - The Guardian

The name Al Muhaymin originates from the Arabic root 'h-m-n', which means to guard, protect, or supervise. In the context of Islamic theology, it reflects Allah's ability to safeguard and preserve the universe and everything within it. It embodies reassurance for believers that their affairs are under divine protection and that Allah is aware of all actions and intentions.
verse:
Al-Qari'ah - The Calamity - 101:6-7

So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, they will be in a life of bliss.
